title: Write and speak
subtitle: Unit 14: Free time and simple plans

steps.title: Writing: Reply to a friend
steps.body:
Write 3 or 4 short lines. Accept or decline an invitation, then give one day or time that works for you.

Write it on paper or in your notes app. Then compare with the model on the next card. You can tap Ask Marie to have her read your text and give one correction.

steps.title: Model answer
steps.body:
Salut Sam. Oui, avec plaisir ! Je suis libre samedi. On va à la patinoire à quinze heures ? À bientôt !

Check:
• Say whether you accept or decline.
• Use avec plaisir or désolé(e).
• Give a clear day or time.

steps.title: Speaking: Talk about a free-time plan
steps.body:
Say one activity you like, invite a friend to do something, and agree on a day and time.

• Use j'aime or je préfère with a noun or infinitive.
• Ask a friendly invitation question.
• Repeat the day and time clearly.

steps.fr: J'aime le hockey et je préfère patiner. Tu veux aller à la patinoire samedi à quinze heures ?
steps.en: Model answer. Say it in your own words after.
steps.tip: Listen, then say it out loud. Tap Ask Marie to have her listen to you.
